t: You're looking at the Jellicoe Memorial Fountain in Trafalgar Square. It's one of the two memorial fountains here, and the architects behind the design are Edwin Lutyens and Charles Barry. Barry is best known for rebuilding the Palace of Westminster, and Lutyens designed many war memorials and public buildings. The sculptor was Charles Wheeler. Have a look at the sculpted details around the basin, and notice how the fountain sits within the wider square.
